description: An agent-based, network-embedded simulation of mask adoption and infectious disease transmission with endogenous behavior shaped by social influence, policies, media messaging, enforcement, and retail supply constraints.

modules.name: EnvironmentAndNetworkBuilder
modules.description: Builds social network with homophily, assigns persons to households/workplaces/schools/retailers, and initializes locations.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if t == 0:
  set RNG seed
  create N persons with attributes (income via lognormal, age_group, political_orientation,...)
  generate social network using degree-corrected SBM: assign blocks by political_orientation; connect with target avg degree and homophily
  form households by sampling sizes ~ Poisson around mean_household_size; assign persons
  create workplaces and schools with sizes ~ Lognormal around workplace_size_mean and school_size_mean
  assign working-age to workplaces, school-age to schools
  create retailers (retailer_count) and assign geospatial tags if needed
  create locations for each household, workplace, school, retail, transit, outdoor (pooled) with base_contact_rate and risk multipliers
  set location policies from global defaults; set open_status = true
notes: Uses homophily to preferentially connect similar political orientations.
Households are cliques for daily contacts.
Workplaces/schools assigned based on age and employment status.

modules.name: MobilityAndContacts
modules.description: Simulates daily movement and generates contact edges at locations, constrained by capacities and open status.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person p:
  determine today's schedule based on age_group and mobility_pattern
  for each visited location L:
    if L.open_status == false: skip
    compute draws = Poisson(contact_rate_L * cap_utilization_limit)
    sample draws unique co-located persons uniformly up to L.capacity and presence
    add undirected contact edges (p, q, L)
store contacts in contacts.daily_location_contacts
notes: Household contacts are always generated daily.
Capacity utilization prevents unrealistically dense mixing.

modules.name: InformationBroadcast
modules.description: Broadcasts messages from HealthAuthority and MediaChannels, updating risk perception and trust.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person p:
  authority_signal = authority_credibility * messaging_intensity * (1 - abs(message_content_bias))
  media_signal = sum_over_channels(credibility_i * reach_weight_i * (1 - misinformation_rate) - misinformation_rate)
  net_signal = authority_signal + media_signal
  p.risk_perception = (1 - risk_perception_decay) * p.risk_perception + risk_perception_update_rate * sigmoid(net_signal)
  p.trust_in_institutions = p.trust_in_institutions + trust_update_rate * (authority_credibility - p.trust_in_institutions)
notes: Net signal is bounded via sigmoid to keep variables in [0,1].
Misinformation reduces effective signal and can be negative.

modules.name: RetailMarket
modules.description: Simulates retail inventory dynamics, pricing, and individual mask purchases.

notes: Supply delay is implemented via a FIFO queue per retailer.
Price adjusts gradually with stockouts to mimic scarcity pricing.

modules.name: MaskAdoptionDecision
modules.description: Determines daily mask-wearing based on risk perception, social norms, policy pressure, and availability.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person p:
  social_norm = mean(mask_use_state of p.network_neighbors) if neighbors else 0
  policy_pressure = 1.0 if (mandate_active and current_day >= mandate_start_day) else 0.0
  expected_enforcement_cost = policy_effect_on_enforcement * policy_pressure
  utility = adoption_threshold_base
  utility += p.risk_perception
  utility += social_influence_weight * (social_norm - 0.5)
  utility += p.compliance_propensity * policy_pressure
  utility -= expected_enforcement_cost * (1 - p.compliance_propensity)
  utility -= political_polarization_effect * polarization_term(p.political_orientation, policy_pressure)
  utility += p.trust_in_institutions - 0.5
  if p.mask_stock <= 0: decide = 0 else decide = Bernoulli(sigmoid(habit_persistence * (1 if p.mask_use_state else -1) + utility))
  p.mask_use_state = (decide == 1)
  if p.mask_use_state: p.mask_stock -= masks_per_day_per_person
notes: Habit persistence biases continuation of prior behavior.
Polarization term penalizes adoption among some orientations when policy is active.

modules.name: PolicyAndEnforcement
modules.description: Sets and enforces mask policies at locations; issues warnings/fines and updates compliance signals.

notes: Compliance signals can raise perceived enforcement probability in adoption decision.
Fines reduce budget if tracked; can feed back into future purchases.

modules.name: DiseaseTransmissionAndProgression
modules.description: Simulates infection events from contacts and SEIR-like progression with mask effects and location risk multipliers.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each contact (i, j, L):
  if disease_state_i in {I_pre, I_sym, I_asym} and disease_state_j == S:
    p_base = base_transmission_prob_per_contact * location_risk_multiplier_<L.type>
    mask_factor = (1 - mask_efficacy_source_control) if i.mask_use_state else 1.0
    mask_factor *= (1 - mask_efficacy_wearer_protection) if j.mask_use_state else 1.0
    effective_p = p_base * mask_factor
    if Bernoulli(effective_p): mark j as E (exposed)
  (symmetry for j->i)
for each person p:
  advance days_in_state += 1
  if state == E and days_in_state >= latent_period_mean +/- noise: move to I_pre or I_asym with prob asymptomatic_fraction
  if state == I_pre and days_in_state >= 2: move to I_sym
  if state in {I_sym, I_asym} and days_in_state >= infectious_period_mean: move to R
  if state == I_sym and Bernoulli(isolation_compliance_prob): reduce their contact participation tomorrow
notes: Progression times can be gamma- or log-normal sampled around means.

modules.name: AggregationAndReporting
modules.description: Aggregates observables and computes Rt, inequality, compliance, costs, and steady-state adoption metrics.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption_rate = mean(p.mask_use_state for p in persons)
infection_incidence = count(new_infections_today)
Rt = infection_incidence / sum_{k=1..K}(w_k * incidence_{t-k}) where w is serial interval PMF from mean/sd
compliance_rate = fraction of non-maskers in mandated contexts receiving enforcement or voluntarily complying (proxied by signals)
enforcement_actions_daily = count(fines + warnings today)
stockouts_rate = fraction(retailers with inventory == 0)
if adoption_rate >= adoption_target_threshold and first_cross_day not set: record today as time_to_target
adoption_gini = Gini(mask_use_state by income deciles determined by inequality_group_bins)
cost_burden = mean( (spend_today / income_daily) among adopters )
risk_perception_avg = mean(p.risk_perception)
steady_state_adoption = mean(adoption_rate over last evaluation_window_days)
store all observables
notes: Rt uses a renewal equation with a discretized serial interval.
Gini computed across individuals with income-based weights into bins.

parameters.description: Average degree of person-to-person social network.
Variance scaler for compliance propensity distribution.
Daily contacts in household per person.
Fraction of location capacity used in contact generation.
How quickly risk perception updates from signals.
Daily decay of risk perception without signals.
Daily trust adjustment toward authority credibility.
Consumption rate of masks by adopters.
Weight of social norm in adoption utility.
Inertia to keep previous mask behavior.
Utility penalty/boost tied to political orientation under mandates.
Whether a mandate is active in the simulation.
How much policy presence raises expected enforcement cost.
Probability of enforcement action when non-compliance is observed.
Chance of inspection/warning issuance per location per day.
Reduction when infectious person wears mask.
Reduction when susceptible person wears mask.
Fraction that passes through pre-symptomatic stage.
Mean serial interval for Rt estimation.
Income quantile bins for inequality measures.

observables.formula_or_field: Gini(mask_use_state by individuals; grouped by income quantiles)

algorithms.SocialNetworkGeneration: Degree-corrected stochastic block model with homophily on political orientation and age groups.
algorithms.DailyContacts: Poisson contact draws per location with capacity constraint and random matching of co-present agents.
algorithms.MaskAdoptionUtility: Logit/Bernoulli choice with components: risk, social norm, policy, enforcement, trust, habit, polarization.
algorithms.RetailSupplyQueue: Retailer-level FIFO pipeline for restocking with stochastic disruptions.
algorithms.SEIRProgression: Discrete-time SEIR with presymptomatic and asymptomatic branches; per-contact Bernoulli transmission.
algorithms.RtEstimation: Renewal equation using discretized gamma serial interval from mean and sd.
algorithms.GiniComputation: Standard Gini coefficient computed on binary adoption weighted by income bins.
